symbols.name: selected chunk count
symbols.meaning: The largest number of equal-width address chunks in which the same bit position is selected.
symbols.quote: On the layouts of the multiplication algorithm, the same bit position is selected in each of at most $d$ equal-width address chunks.

symbols.name: layer chunk count
symbols.meaning: The number of selected address chunks that the layer acts on, at most $d$.
symbols.quote: The layer acts on $D$ selected chunks, where $1 \le D \le d$.

symbols.name: stored volume
symbols.meaning: The logical bit volume of the stored array.
symbols.quote: Here $V$ is the logical bit volume of the stored array.

symbols.name: cost exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below 1 in the layer's cost bound.
symbols.quote: Here $\lambda'$ is a fixed exponent below 1, so the cost grows more slowly than $d$ full passes over the array.

symbols.name: two-point map
symbols.meaning: The map sending a pair $(u,v)$ to $((u+v)/2, (u-v)/2)$.

symbols.name: complex two-point kernel
symbols.meaning: The auxiliary complex two-point kernel, a $2\times 2$ complex matrix.
symbols.quote: The complex two-point kernel $C$ is a $2\times 2$ complex matrix.

relations.quote: The tensor product of $C$ is realized by a [complex phase network](complex-phase-network.md) with dyadic frame changes.

relations.predicate: keeps its intermediate values exact in
relations.quote: The layer keeps its intermediate values exact in [Gaussian dyadics](gaussian-dyadics.md).
The layer moves its address chunks by [address-field interchange](address-interchange.md), which realizes these changes of basis.
The map $H_0$ is the normalized [discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) of length 2, so the layer is a tensor product of such transforms.
